obligation_records.statement: Shell/scope belongs in route_target; persistence/provenance in storage; generated:// and backing_document_id are resolver/transport details, not OpenSubject fields.
obligation_records.evidence_ledger_excerpt:
Those fields belong elsewhere:
  - shell and scope belong to `route_target`
  - persistence/provenance belong to storage records and projections
  - transport/open realization belongs to the resolver that executes `OpenSubject`
- `generated://<artifact_id>` is not a subject field.
exact_items: generated:// and backing_document_id are resolver/transport details, not OpenSubject fields.
